args.title: Fix password reset email link to use the correct base URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email uses the BASE_URL constant that falls back to "http://localhost:3000" when process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set. This causes reset links in emails to point to localhost, which is incorrect for deployed environments.

Proposed change: Adjust the way BASE_URL is set or ensure process.env.PUBLIC_URL is properly set in the deployment so that the reset-password link in the email uses the correct public URL instead of localhost.
